sloka: अयं मुहूर्तात् सुग्रीवो लब्धसञ्ज्ञो महाहवे।आत्मनो वानराणां च यत् पथ्यं तत् करिष्यति ।। ६.६७.७९ ।।
transliteration: ayaṁ muhūrtāt sugrīvo labdhasañjño mahāhave।ātmano vānarāṇāṁ ca yat pathyaṁ tat kariṣyati ।। 6.67.79 ।।

translations.english: "I think that Sugriva, hit by Kumbhakarna with a mountain, has lost senses and is not able to know."
